mapping.summary: HR platform for employee records, hiring, onboarding, time off, reviews and training, synced with BC
claims: Employee directory with org chart and document storage
More than 25 configurable custom fields per employee
Employee self-service for profile, contacts and documents
Ten-stage hiring pipeline with candidate portal and talent bank
One-click conversion of a hire into an employee
Time-off requests with approval and manager notifications
Review cycles with goals, competency frameworks and manager sign-off
Mandatory certification tracking and learning catalog
Benefit plan enrollment and deduction reporting
Entra ID account provisioning on hire and revocation on termination
Two-way employee sync with BC set up via wizard
Role-based access with 38 permissions and full audit trail
Priced per employee per month in three tiers, BC sync from Professional tier
